note: New writing for the web prologue (2026-10-18). Not original game content. See docs/story/prologue-lost-light.md.

text.zh-CN: 很久以前，哈奇岛的每一句咒语都由文字写成，最亮的一个字叫“光”。
text.en: Long ago, every spell in Haqi was written in words, and the brightest word was "Light".

text.zh-CN: 第一幕 · 黑暗降临
text.en: Act 1 · Darkness Falls

text.zh-CN: 最亮的“光”，现在归我了！
text.en: The brightest word, Light, is mine now!

text.zh-CN: 灯灭了，路牌上的字也不见了……我找不到回家的路。
text.en: The lamps went out and the signpost words are gone... I can't find my way home.

text.zh-CN: 烈火、寒冰、风暴、生命——四系大师齐聚营地！我们联手把“光”夺回来！
text.en: Fire, Ice, Storm, Life — the four masters are here! Let's team up and take Light back!

text.zh-CN: 四个人？尝尝死亡系的魔法！
text.en: Four of you? Taste the magic of Death!

text.zh-CN: 没有光，你们的咒语也念不出来！
text.en: Without Light, your spells can't be spoken!

text.zh-CN: 魔王被击退时，“光”碎成一笔一笔，散落到群岛与远方的城市。
text.en: As the Dark Lord was pushed back, Light shattered into strokes across the islands and distant cities.

text.zh-CN: 糟糕，没有文字，我们的卡牌变成空白了！
text.en: Oh no, without words, our cards went blank!

text.zh-CN: 第二幕 · 一点火花
text.en: Act 2 · A Spark Falls

text.zh-CN: 有一笔光，落到了好奇的你面前。
text.en: One stroke of light fell right in front of you.

prompt.en: Tap to catch the stroke of light

text.zh-CN: 你能看见失落的文字！帮我们把这一笔写回去吧。
text.en: You can see the lost words! Help us write this stroke back.

text.zh-CN: 第三幕 · 找回光
text.en: Act 3 · Bringing Back the Light

text.zh-CN: 写出“光”，它就会化作真正的魔法文字卡！
text.en: Write Light, and it will become a real magic word card!

text.zh-CN: 太棒了！“光”回来了，大师们的卡牌也重新亮起来了！
text.en: Wonderful! Light is back, and the masters' cards are shining again!

text.zh-CN: 第四幕 · 再次出击
text.en: Act 4 · Strike Again

text.zh-CN: 小鬼们，去把那点光扑灭！
text.en: Go, my imps! Put out that little light!

text.zh-CN: 我们的三张招牌魔法回来了，还多了你亲手写出的“光”之文字卡！
text.en: Our three signature spells are back, plus the Light word card you wrote!

text.zh-CN: 再来一场 4 对 2！除了之前的 3 张卡，还可以点选你写的“光”之文字卡！
text.en: Let's fight 4 vs 2! Besides the 3 cards from before, you can also pick the Light word card you wrote!

text.zh-CN: 这就是你写的“光”！
text.en: That's the Light you wrote!

text.zh-CN: 干得好！小鬼们被击退了。
text.en: Well done! The imps ran away.

text.zh-CN: 别灰心，小鬼们已经被光吓跑了！
text.en: Don't worry, the light already scared the imps away!

text.zh-CN: 路牌又亮了！我知道怎么回家了！
text.en: The sign is shining again! Now I know the way home!

text.zh-CN: 还有许多字散落在群岛和城市里。每找回一个字，你的魔法就强一分！
text.en: Many words are still lost across the islands and cities. Every word you find makes your magic stronger!

text.zh-CN: 魔法哈奇
text.en: Magic Haqi
